Requires an <arc Arc /> subclass.

source.text:
While on an Arc Subclass:

Scoring 3 Precision Hits within 3 seconds of each inflicts Jolt.
Jolt's Damage is unaffected by buffs or modifiers.

Incurs a 10 second cooldown upon triggering.
